summary: The PR adds a full Key Manager (Barbican) area — BFF router with Zod schemas, a permission router, nav entry and Secrets/Containers/Orders tabs with list, detail, create and delete — and CI is green. What matters most is the Barbican contract: Reveal Payload sends no `Accept` matching the secret's content type, so typical secrets fail with 406, and removing a secret from a container and sorting orders use endpoints/params the reference does not document. On the client, the Reveal Payload action is not permission-gated, the nav entry ignores `enabledServices`/`deniedServices`, create forms mutate without validation, search navigates on every keystroke and CRUD success shows no toast. Against epic #1133 most criteria are only partly met (no update/manage-secrets UI, Orders columns, error text, tests), and a changeset is missing.
index_affected: New `KeyManager` server domain (keyManagerRouter, permissionRouter, Zod types) merged into the app router; Authorization > Key Manager nav entry; key-manager routes with Secrets/Containers/Orders lists, details and modals.

c45.issue: `getSecretPayload` sends the default `Accept: application/json`, so Barbican answers 406 for most secrets
c45.title: Reveal Payload does not set `Accept` to the secret's content type
c45.explanation:
`getSecretPayload` fetches the payload with no headers:

[[code:packages/aurora/src/server/KeyManager/routers/keyManagerRouter.ts | v1/secrets/${encodeURIComponent(input.secretId)}/payload | 1]]

The session's default headers send `Accept: application/json`, while the Barbican reference for `GET /v1/secrets/{uuid}/payload` says the accept header must be one of the values in the secret's `content_types`. For `text/plain` or `application/octet-stream` secrets — the common case — Barbican returns 406 Not Acceptable, and `mapKmError` has no 406 entry, so the user sees a generic internal error and Reveal Payload is broken. No test covers a non-JSON content type.
c45.fix: Read the secret's metadata (or take its `content_types.default` from the client) and pass it as the `Accept` header on the payload request; map 406/415 in `mapKmError`.

c6.issue: Create modals mutate without validation; Bit Length is sent as `NaN` when empty
c6.title: Create Order/Secret/Container forms have no validation or inline errors
c6.explanation:
The Create Order modal sends `parseInt(bitLength, 10)` (NaN for an empty field; zero and negative values are accepted), the algorithm may be empty, and the confirm button is disabled only while the mutation is pending:

[[code:packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/authorization/key-manager/orders/-components/OrderModals.tsx | bit_length: parseInt(bitLength, 10) | 1]]

The secret and container create modals have no validator either. This breaks B.5/B.11 (confirm disabled while required fields are empty or invalid) — bad input reaches Barbican and only comes back as a message at the top of the form. Copilot raised the bit-length case on `OrderModals.tsx:52`; no reply.
c6.fix: Validate required fields and a positive integer bit length (react-form + Zod, as elsewhere), show inline errors and keep Create disabled until the form is valid.

c8.issue: Create and delete of secrets, containers and orders show no confirming toast
c8.title: CRUD success is silent
c8.explanation: On success the modals only invalidate the query and close; there is no `toast` and no `*ToastNotifications` helper anywhere under `key-manager/`. B.16/B.10 require a transient confirming toast for create/update/delete, extracted into a `<Resource>ToastNotifications.tsx`.
c8.fix: Add `SecretToastNotifications`/`ContainerToastNotifications`/`OrderToastNotifications` helpers and show a toast from each mutation's `onSuccess`.

c11.issue: Reveal Payload and the detail views ignore `key-manager:secrets:payload` / `get` permissions
c11.title: Reveal Payload is not permission-gated (not fail-closed)
c11.explanation:
The Reveal Payload button is rendered unconditionally:

[[code:packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/authorization/key-manager/secrets/-components/SecretDetailsView.tsx | <Button variant="subdued" onClick={handleRevealPayload} disabled={payloadFetching}> | 1]]

`key-manager:secrets:payload` is defined in the permission router and the hook's types but no client code reads it; none of the `*DetailsView` files call the permissions hook. Users without payload rights see a working control that triggers a plaintext fetch — only Barbican's own ACLs stop it. This violates the Quick Reject rule on controls shown before permissions resolve and leaves the epic's "all action-triggering elements gated" criterion partly met. Copilot flagged it as CRITICAL (r4360388886); no reply.
c11.fix: Check `key-manager:secrets:payload` (and `get` for the detail routes) via the permissions hook, defaulting to false while loading, and hide or disable the button until allowed.

c13.issue: Search inputs navigate on every keystroke, with no local state or debounce
c13.title: Secrets/Containers search fires a navigation and a request per character
c13.explanation:
`SearchInput` calls `onSearchChange` on every input event:

[[code:packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/authorization/key-manager/secrets/-components/SecretsList.tsx | onInput={(e) => onSearchChange((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)} | 1]]

`handleSearch` in `secrets/index.tsx` calls `navigate()` without debounce or `replace`, so each keystroke changes the URL, resets the page, adds a history entry and fires a new `listSecrets` request. Same in `ContainersList.tsx:74`. B.9 asks for a local mirror state with debounce, as the flavors list does (500 ms).
c13.fix: Keep the input value in local state, debounce the navigation (and use `replace: true`), and sync back from the URL in a `useEffect`.

c24.issue: Search navigation per keystroke pollutes back-history and churns requests
c24.title: Search writes a history entry per character
c24.explanation: Same root cause as [[ref:c13]], seen from the history side.

c33.title: Removing a secret from a container uses the wrong Barbican endpoint
c33.explanation:
The procedure deletes by path segment and takes only `containerId` and `secretName`:

[[code:packages/aurora/src/server/KeyManager/routers/keyManagerRouter.ts:252-252]]

The Barbican containers reference documents removal only as `DELETE /v1/containers/{container_uuid}/secrets` with a JSON body `{ "name", "secret_ref" }`, where `secret_ref` is required (400 "Missing secret_ref"). The path form is not in the reference, so the call will fail once a UI uses it; the router test asserts the same wrong URL. Copilot raised it (r4360389656); no reply.
c33.fix: Send `DELETE v1/containers/{id}/secrets` with a body `{ name, secret_ref }`, add `secret_ref` to the input schema, and update the test.

c34.issue: Container `secret_refs[].name` is required `z.string()`, but Barbican allows unnamed refs
c34.title: An unnamed secret reference makes the whole container response fail validation
c34.explanation:
[[code:packages/aurora/src/server/KeyManager/types/keyManager.ts:25-25]]

`name` is optional for container secret references in the reference, and sibling `name` fields in this file are `.nullable()`. A container with an unnamed ref returns `name: null`, `parseOrThrow` rejects it, and the whole container list fails to load. Copilot raised it (r4360389713); no reply.
c34.fix: Make it `name: z.string().nullable().optional()` and render a fallback in the UI.

c39.issue: Deleting the last row on the last page leaves an empty table with no pagination
c39.title: List `page` is not clamped after a delete
c39.explanation:
`offset` is `(page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE` and `totalPages` comes from `data.total`, but nothing clamps `page` when the total shrinks. Pagination is hidden when there is one page:

[[code:packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/authorization/key-manager/secrets/-components/SecretsList.tsx | {totalPages > 1 && ( | 1]]

So after deleting the only row of the last page the user sees an empty table with no way back. Same in the Containers and Orders lists; Copilot raised all three (r4360389532, r4360389254, r4360389387), no replies.
c39.fix: When `page > totalPages` after data loads, navigate to `max(totalPages, 1)` with `replace: true`.

c41.issue: Key Manager nav entry and route ignore `enabledServices` / `deniedServices`
c41.title: Key Manager can't be hidden through service-visibility config
c41.explanation:
The new nav item is gated only on the catalog:

[[code:packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/-components/buildNavSections.ts | ...(serviceIndex["key-manager"]?.["barbican"] | 1]]

Every other built-in item uses `&& isEnabled(...)`, whose comment says deny always wins. A host cannot hide Key Manager via `deniedServices` or leave it out of an `enabledServices` allowlist, and the `key-manager.tsx` `beforeLoad` also checks only the catalog, so a denied service stays reachable by URL. The project overview (`projects/$projectId/index.tsx`) gets no Key Manager card either.
c41.fix: Add `&& isEnabled("key-manager")` to the nav item, apply the same check in the route `beforeLoad`, add the card on the project overview and document the service key in the README.

c44.issue: `listOrders` sends undocumented `sort_key`/`sort_dir`; the Orders sort control does nothing
c44.title: Orders sort uses parameters Barbican doesn't support
c44.explanation:
[[code:packages/aurora/src/server/KeyManager/routers/keyManagerRouter.ts:269-273]]

The Barbican reference for `GET /v1/orders` documents only `offset` and `limit`; `sort_key`/`sort_dir` appear nowhere in the secrets, containers or orders references. The Sort by / direction controls in `OrdersList.tsx` are visible but have no documented effect.
c44.fix: Remove the sort control from the Orders tab (or sort client-side within the page) and drop the sort params from `listOrders`.

c1.issue: Permission props are named `canDelete` instead of `can<Verb><Noun>`
c1.title: Permission prop naming
c1.explanation: `SecretTableRow.tsx:15` has `canDelete: boolean`; the same in `ContainerTableRow`, `OrderTableRow` and the three `*ListContainer.tsx`. B.8 requires `canDeleteSecret` etc. Copilot raised it on all six files; no replies.

c2.issue: Row `PopupMenu` has no `PopupMenuToggle` with a labelled `moreVert` button
c2.title: Row action menus lack the standard toggle
c2.explanation: `SecretTableRow.tsx:35` renders `<PopupMenu><PopupMenuOptions>` with no `PopupMenuToggle`, so the default toggle is used without an accessible label (also `ContainerTableRow.tsx:34`, `OrderTableRow.tsx:33`). B.14 requires `<PopupMenuToggle as="div"><Button icon="moreVert" /></PopupMenuToggle>`. Copilot raised it (r4360388832).
c2.fix: Use `PopupMenuToggle` with an icon `Button` carrying an `aria-label`, as the network views do.

c3.issue: Row menu items `Show Details` / `Delete` lack the entity name and a separator before Delete
c3.title: Row menu labels and Delete separator
c3.explanation: `SecretTableRow.tsx:37-38` lists `Show Details` then `Delete` with no `PopupMenuSectionSeparator`; same in the container and order rows. B.18 asks to name the entity in labels and separate Delete with a divider.
c3.fix: Label as `Show Secret Details` / `Delete Secret` and add a `PopupMenuSectionSeparator` before Delete.

c4.issue: Delete modals put the name/ID in the title and use a bare `Delete` confirm label
c4.title: Delete modal wording
c4.explanation: `SecretModals.tsx:129` uses ``title={t`Delete Secret "${secretName}"`}`` while the body doesn't name the entity and the confirm label is `Delete`; the order modal title shows a raw UUID (`OrderModals.tsx:125`, `ContainerModals.tsx:109`). B.5 puts the object name in the body and asks for verb + object labels.
c4.fix: Title `Delete Secret`, name the entity in the body, confirm label `Delete Secret`.

c5.issue: Modals disable Cancel but not the close-X while a mutation is pending
c5.title: Missing `disableCloseButton` during async operations
c5.explanation: All six modals pass only `disableCancelButton={…isPending}` (e.g. `SecretModals.tsx:136`, `:60`), so the user can dismiss mid-request. B.5 / Quick Reject require disabling close-X and Cancel together, as `DeleteFlavorModal` does.
c5.fix: Add `disableCloseButton={mutation.isPending}` to every create and delete modal.

c7.issue: Create modals use `useState` without react-form, `autoFocus` or disabled inputs in flight
c7.title: Create forms don't follow the form standard
c7.explanation: `ContainerModals.tsx:30` keeps `name` in `useState`; no create modal uses `@tanstack/react-form` + Zod, sets `autoFocus` on the primary input, or disables inputs while the mutation runs (B.11). Validation itself is [[ref:c6]].
c7.fix: Move the create forms to react-form with Zod validators, add `autoFocus` and `disabled={isPending}` on inputs.

c9.issue: Sort uses raw `Select` + `SortButton` instead of `SortInput`; toolbar uses `distribution="end"`
c9.title: List toolbar doesn't use `SortInput`
c9.explanation: `SecretsList.tsx:93` and `OrdersList.tsx:76` build sorting from `Select` and `SortButton` in a `Stack distribution="end"`; B.1/B.2 require `SortInput` from `@/client/components/ListToolbar/SortInput` and `distribution="between"`. The Containers list has no sort control at all.
c9.fix: Replace with `SortInput` and use `distribution="between"` for the toolbar.

c10.issue: 403 on list pages is an inline warning `Message` with hard-coded English
c10.title: Permission-denied state is not page-level
c10.explanation: `SecretsList.tsx:72`, `ContainersList.tsx:50` and `OrdersList.tsx:55` render `<Message variant="warning">You do not have permission to view …</Message>` without `mb-4` and without Lingui. B.6 expects a page-level info `Message` for 403.
c10.fix: Use a translated page-level info `Message` (with `mb-4`), matching the recommended 403 copy.

c12.issue: Detail routes fetch in the component (twice) instead of in the route `loader`
c12.title: Detail data not loaded in the route loader
c12.explanation: `containers/$containerId.tsx:19` and `ContainerDetailsView` both call `getContainer.useQuery` (same for secrets and orders), and the routes have no `loader`. React Query dedupes the request, but A.3 asks for page-critical data in the loader.
c12.fix: Fetch in the route `loader` and pass the data (or rely on one query) to the details view.

c14.issue: Ad-hoc spacing/styling classes (`my-6`, `mt-4`, `p-3`, `opacity-60`) outside the approved lists
c14.title: Off-standard spacing and muted text
c14.explanation: E.g. `className="my-6"` on the detail stacks, `opacity-60` instead of `text-theme-light` at `SecretDetailsView.tsx:97`, and `mt-4` in `key-manager.tsx`. B.3/B.4 reject classes outside the approved lists.
c14.fix: Use the approved spacing (`mt-6` detail offset) and `text-theme-light` for muted text.

c15.issue:
Raw `
`, `

`, `

` used where Juno components exist
c15.title: Raw HTML instead of Juno layout primitives
c15.explanation: `key-manager.tsx` wraps content in `<div className="mt-4">`, rows and pagination use `<div>`s, and `SecretDetailsView.tsx` wraps the button in a `<div>`. Quick Reject / B.1 prefer `Stack` and other Juno components.
c15.fix: Replace the wrappers with `Stack`/`Container` and the text elements with Juno equivalents.

c16.title: File and hook naming
c16.explanation: `usePermissions.ts:21` exports a generic `usePermissions(projectId, permissions)`; B.8 asks for `useKeyManagerPermissions(projectId)`. `SecretModals.tsx` etc. bundle several modals where B.12 wants `<Verb><Resource>Modal.tsx`. Copilot asked for `useKeyManagerPermissions` (r4360389782).
c16.fix: Rename the hook to `useKeyManagerPermissions` and split modals into `CreateSecretModal.tsx`, `DeleteSecretModal.tsx`, …

c19.issue: Empty state suggests creating even when a search returned no results
c19.title: Empty state doesn't distinguish no data from no matches
c19.explanation: `SecretListContainer.tsx:59` always shows the create hint and doesn't receive `search`; same in `ContainerListContainer.tsx:58`. The hint is also shown to users without create permission. B.6 asks to distinguish the two reasons.
c19.fix: Pass `search` in and show "No results — clear the search" when filtering.

c20.issue: Error states show the raw `error.message` as title with no body or retry
c20.title: Error state lacks explanation and retry
c20.explanation: ``<Status status="error" title={error?.message ?? t`Failed to Load Secrets`} />`` at `SecretListContainer.tsx:33`, and the same in the other list containers and detail views. B.6 asks for a course of action (retry) where feasible.
c20.fix: Use a fixed translated title, the message as body and a retry action.

c25.title: Binary secrets are corrupted when revealed
c25.explanation:
[[code:packages/aurora/src/server/KeyManager/routers/keyManagerRouter.ts:102-104]]

An `application/octet-stream` secret (e.g. a symmetric key) is UTF-8-decoded and shown as garbage in the `<pre>`; there is no base64 path.
c25.fix: For non-text content types read `arrayBuffer()` and return base64 with a flag so the UI can label it.

c28.issue: Key Manager has no project-overview card and its route ignores visibility config
c28.title: Project overview and route guard out of sync with nav

c32.issue: Secret plaintext can land in server logs via signal-openstack's debug body preview
c32.title: Payload logged in non-production debug mode
c32.explanation: Debug is on by default outside production (`context.ts:114`), and signal-openstack logs a `bodyPreview` for text responses, so a `text/plain` secret fetched by `getSecretPayload` is written to the logs (truncated). Copilot flagged it as CRITICAL (r4360389080); no reply.
c32.fix: Disable body preview for the payload request (or redact `/payload` responses in the client's debug logging).

c55.issue: Orders list lacks the Name column from the epic's UI spec
c55.title: Orders columns don't match the spec
c55.explanation: Epic #1133 lists Orders columns Name / ID, Type, Status; `orders/-components/constants.ts:1` has `ID`, `Status`, `Type` and the row shows no name or reference.
c55.fix: Show the order's name/secret reference alongside the ID, or note the deviation in the epic.

c56.issue: No update UI: `updateSecret`, `addContainerSecret`, `deleteContainerSecret` have no client caller
c56.title: Update / manage-container-secrets flows are missing
c56.explanation: The epic criterion is list, view, create, update and delete. The server procedures exist but no client code calls them — no Edit Secret modal, no way to attach secrets to a container (`secret_refs: []` on create), and Create Secret offers only name, type and payload.
c56.fix: Add the update/manage flows, or state in the PR which part of #1133 this delivers and track the rest.

c57.issue: Epic criterion "all actions gated by canUser" only partly met
c57.title: Reveal Payload ungated

c58.issue: `mapKmError` drops Barbican's error body; users see generic `Key Manager … failed`
c58.title: Error messages aren't user-friendly
c58.explanation: `keyManagerRouter.ts:52` builds the message as `Key Manager ${operation} failed` and the `!res.ok` paths pass only the status code, so a 409 (e.g. deleting a container in use) gets no specific text. The epic asks for user-friendly feedback for Barbican errors.
c58.fix: Read Barbican's `description`/`title` from the error body and include it in the TRPCError message.

c60.issue: No tests for lists with permissions, modals, detail views, nav or layout guard; no E2E
c60.title: Test coverage below the epic's criterion
c60.explanation: Tests cover the router, the schemas and the TableRow/ListContainer components only; the epic asks for unit, integration and E2E coverage.
c60.fix: Add component tests for lists (permission states), modals and details, a nav/guard test and a basic E2E.

c17.issue: Import order and `../../` relative imports break B.13
c17.title: Import order and path aliases
c17.explanation: `SecretsList.tsx` imports `@/client/trpcClient` after Juno and `usePermissions` via `../../-components/usePermissions`; `SecretModals.tsx` imports `useState` after Juno. B.13 orders react, i18n, tRPC, Juno and forbids `../../` traversal.
c17.fix: Reorder imports and switch to `@/` aliases.

edge_cases: Reveal Payload on a `text/plain` or `application/octet-stream` secret: Barbican should return 406 because `Accept: application/json` is sent ([[ref:c45]]); a binary secret that does load shows garbled text ([[ref:c25]]).
Remove a secret from a generic container via `deleteContainerSecret`: the path-segment DELETE is not a documented endpoint and should fail ([[ref:c33]]).
Load a container whose `secret_refs` contains an unnamed reference (`name: null`): the containers list fails validation ([[ref:c34]]).
With more than 50 secrets, go to the last page holding a single item and delete it: an empty table with no pagination remains ([[ref:c39]]).
Set `deniedServices` to include `key-manager` (or an `enabledServices` list without it): the Key Manager nav entry still shows and the route is reachable by URL ([[ref:c41]]).
On the Orders tab change Sort by / direction: the order of rows should not change, since Barbican ignores `sort_key`/`sort_dir` ([[ref:c44]]).
As a user without `key-manager:secrets:payload`, open a secret's details: Reveal Payload is still shown and clickable ([[ref:c11]]).

fixes.old: The Authorization section is always emitted, but with an empty `services` list when Barbican is absent.
fixes.new: The Authorization section is seeded in the section map with an empty `services` list when Barbican is absent, but `buildNavSections` ends with `.filter((s) => s.services.length > 0)`, so the empty section is dropped from the returned nav model.

fixes.old: **Nav.** The Authorization section is now always present in the nav model, even when empty. Check that an empty section does not render as an empty header.
fixes.new: **Nav.** The Authorization section is seeded in the section map, but the existing final `.filter((s) => s.services.length > 0)` removes it when it has no services, so without Barbican the nav is unchanged. With Barbican present, a new Authorization section appears.
